Lessons: Why Original Languages Matter; Using Strong's Numbers and Lexicons; hesed — Steadfast Love; shalom — Peace and Wholeness; agape and charis — Love and Grace; elpis and agkura — Hope and Anchor in Hebrews 6:19; pistis — Faith; Word Studies in Practice
Description: For learners ready to go beneath the translation, this advanced course opens up the richness of Hebrew and Greek. You will work with key words like hesed, shalom, agape — and elpis and agkura, the hope and anchor of Hebrews 6:19 that gave this blog its name. Careful tools, deep rewards.
